symptoms: Floral parts converted into green leafy structures; floral proliferation and stunted plant
management: Rogue and destroy infected phyllody plants
prevention: Spray Monocrotophos or Imidacloprid to control leafhoppers (Orosius albicinctus)

healthy_signs: Thick, deep-green foliage with vigorous vegetative spread
Uniform capitulum/pod development free from sucking pest damage
Clean stem base without collar rot or gummy exudates
Bright yellow flower opening with high honeybee activity
management: Remove weed hosts from field margins that harbor sucking pests and viral inoculum
Spray recommended protective fungicides or bio-agents on appearance of initial leaf spots
Avoid moisture stress during flowering and pod development phases
prevention: Sow treated seeds in well-drained loamy soils during recommended planting window
Maintain optimum field density and destroy crop residues after harvest
Apply recommended gypsum and sulfur for healthy seed and oil development
Monitor regularly for early nymph/larval infestation
